title: LoadShapesReport v1 — the published load shapes: the measurement plan, one measured shape per planned size in plan order (the mesh's own cost as published numbers — join cost and steady heartbeat/gossip cost per node count), the totals across every measured size, every refusal counted apart by name, and every measurement act's record; simulated is a constant — the numbers were counted in the in-process simulator and are never hardware proof (Y-072)
